**Log and board file**

<!--
Papertie's log often says what went wrong:
  macOS    ~/Library/Logs/Papertie/papertie.log
  Windows  %APPDATA%\Papertie\logs\papertie.log
  Linux    ~/.config/Papertie/logs/papertie.log

If the problem depends on what is on your board, a board file helps a lot
(Settings → Export → Download .papertie). Please remember that it contains
your notes, photos and books in full: only attach it if you are happy for
everyone to read them, or make a small board that shows the problem instead.
